subject: Request: Subprocessor roster + DPA addendum for upcoming procurement review
messages:
From: Amelia Turner <amelia.turner@brightlinefin.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@brightlinefin.com
Date: 2025-06-24T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Requesting current subprocessor roster + DPA addendum ahead of procurement panel

Hi Jordan,

We're kicking off our procurement review next week and Legal/Security asked for a complete subprocessor roster (including country of processing, encryption at rest details, and whether any subprocessors can access plaintext data). They also asked for your proposed DPA addendum addressing cross-border transfers and a short note on whether you have an onshore fallback option for EU-resident processing in the event of an export restriction.

Can you send the roster and any draft addendum we can share with our InfoSec team today? If you can flag anything that typically requires an exception or SLA change (e.g., HSM/KMS arrangements, retention carve-outs), that would help speed our review.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call this afternoon if easier.

Amelia Turner
Head of Procurement, Brightline Fintech
amelia.turner@brightlinefin.com
Attachment: procurement_checklist.xlsx (referenced)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Amelia Turner <amelia.turner@brightlinefin.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2025-06-24T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Requesting current subprocessor roster + DPA addendum ahead of procurement panel

Hi Amelia — thanks for the heads up.

We're on it. Looping in Marissa (account lead) and Kimberly (legal) to get you an authoritative roster and a DPA addendum draft. I'll also check with our infra team about the onshore fallback and any latency/cost implications. Expect a consolidated packet within the day.

Two quick asks so we can prioritize: 1) Do you need SOC2 evidence for each vendor, or is a roster + encryption/export details sufficient for the initial panel? 2) If the panel is strictly the procurement committee, send the headcount and timeline so we can align the call.

I'll follow up after we pull the roster.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com

Date: 2025-06-24T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Requesting current subprocessor roster + DPA addendum ahead of procurement panel

Jordan / Marissa —

I drafted a DPA addendum that covers: subprocessor disclosure obligations, export/transfer safeguards (standard SCCs reference + technical measures), KMS/HSM controls, and an emergency onshore fallback clause that can be exercised with 14 days' notice under exceptional regulatory constraints. Please find the draft attached (dpa_addendum_draft.pdf).

A few legal flags for the roster:
- For any subprocessor that performs plaintext transformations (rare), we need to list the specific operational scope and whether they are personnel-limited and audited annually.
- Where encryption keys are customer-managed, call that out — customers frequently want KMS control to remain with them.
- For EU residency requests: we can provide regional routing for inference (on Dedicated or Private deployments) but for hosted workloads we generally provide best-effort onshore failover via partner pools; this can have latency/cost implications.

Amelia — if you can confirm whether Brightline requires per-vendor SOC2 reports, we will prioritize packaging evidence. If they need full attestations, we'll need a follow-up doc request and ~3 business days to collect vendor artifacts.

Kimberly Park
Head of Legal Operations, Redwood Inference
Attachment: dpa_addendum_draft.pdf

Subject: Re: Requesting current subprocessor roster + DPA addendum ahead of procurement panel

Quick infra note from my side:

I attached the latest subprocessor export (subprocessor_roster_v2.csv) and a short export_control_matrix.xlsx that maps data flows by country and which subprocessors handle tokenization, telemetry, model hosting, and backups. Highlights:
- We do not send plaintext to any EU-based telemetry processors; telemetry is pseudonymized by default.
- Model inference for the hosted product may transit non-EU regions depending on traffic; for Brightline we can pin model serving to EU Dedicated pools or Private on-prem to satisfy residency.
- Onshore fallback: technically feasible for dedicated/pinned customers. For hosted customers, we have a partner bridge that can be engaged, but it requires a DPA addendum + single-tenant routing (there is a one-time configuration and slight cost delta).

Estimated time to compile SOC2 evidence per vendor: 2-3 business days if requested.

Jonas Weber
Director, Inference Infrastructure
Attachment: subprocessor_roster_v2.csv; export_control_matrix.xlsx

Subject: Re: Requesting current subprocessor roster + DPA addendum ahead of procurement panel

Amelia — attaching everything Kimberly/Jonas referenced: the subprocessor roster (CSV), our DPA addendum draft, and an export control matrix that maps processing by country. Key callouts up front:

- Residency: we can guarantee EU residency for Dedicated/Private deployments. For hosted workloads we can offer a pinned partner bridge as an onshore fallback with a small configuration and cost delta (details in the export_control_matrix.xlsx).
- Plaintext access: none of our telemetry or standard hosted subprocessors have routine access to customer plaintext. Any vendor that requires transformation of data in the clear is flagged in the roster with mitigations (personnel restrictions + audit cadence).
- Evidence: we can package per-vendor SOC2/ISO attestations if your panel requires them; please confirm and we will collect and deliver within 3 business days.

Next steps:
1) If your procurement panel is today/tomorrow, suggest a 30-min call to walk Legal/Security through the roster and DPA draft. I've proposed a slot at 10:30am PT tomorrow — please let me know if that works and who from your team will join.
2) If Brightline wants the DPA redlined, Kimberly will take comments and create a customer-facing addendum for signature.

HubSpot record: https://hubspot.company/record/BR-2387
Draft DPA doc: https://docs.redwood.com/dpa-addendum/draft-v2

Thanks — Jordan
Jordan Blake
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
